header.running_head: The Abstinence of Rasulullaah ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) and How they Left the World Without Bothering About it

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) says, "A woman from the Ansaar once visited me and noticed that the bedding of Rasulullaah ﷺ was merely a double-folded sheet. She then sent me a bedding that was filled with wool. When Rasulullaah ﷺ came to me, he asked, "What is this, O Aa'isha?" I then informed him that the Ansaari lady had come and when she saw the bedding, she left and sent this bedding. Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Return it, O Aa'isha. By Allaah! if I wanted, Allaah would make mountains of gold and silver travel with me."[^2]
The Food and Clothing of Rasulullaah ﷺ

Hadhrat Anas (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ wore woollen clothing and patched shoes. He also said that Rasulullaah ﷺ ate Bashi and his clothing was made of coarse cloth. When someone asked Hadhrat Hasan what Bashi was, he replied that it was coarsely ground barley which Rasulullaah ﷺ only managed to swallow with a sip of water.[^3]
The Incident of Rasulullaah ﷺ and Hadhrat Ummu Ayman (RA)

Hadhrat Ummu Ayman (RA) narrates that she once sifted some flour and made bread for Rasulullaah ﷺ (with the refined flour rather than with the coarse flour Rasulullaah ﷺ was used to). (When she served it to Rasulullaah ﷺ,) He asked, "What is this?" Hadhrat Ummu Ayman (RA) replied, "It is something we prepare in our country (Abyssinia) and I wished to make you some bread from it." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "Put is back in the mill and knead it again (so that it can be made into a coarse type of bread)."[^4]

Hadhrat Salma (RA) the wife of Hadhrat Abu Raafi (RA) reports that Hadhrat Hasan bin Ali (RA), Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Ja'far (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) once came to her and said, "Make for us some food that Rasulullaah ﷺ liked to eat." She said to them, "But you may not like it nowadays (because you are used to better foods)." However, she stood up and ground some barley. She then blew off the very rough chaff and made some bread.
